PCP2.title: Copy your opponent and lose your queen on move 6 #shorts
PCP2.desc:
1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nf6 3.Nxe5 Nxe4 4.Qe2. Black pulls the knight back with 4...Nf6, and it's the mistake: 5.Nc6+ is a discovered check from the queen on e2, and after the block 6.Nxd8 takes the black queen. It's the Petrov Defense. Black plays 3...d6 first.

Would you have copied?

#chess #petrovdefense #chesstraps

PCP2.ig:

DAM2.title: Protect your pawn with f6 and lose a rook on move 6 #shorts
DAM2.desc:
1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 f6? 3.Nxe5 fxe5? 4.Qh5+ g6 5.Qxe5+ Qe7 6.Qxh8. The queen checks twice and lands in the corner. It's the Damiano Defense, and the mistake was 2...f6.

Have you ever played f6 here?

#chess #damianodefense #chesstraps

QGA2.title: Keep the extra pawn and lose a knight on move 7 #shorts
QGA2.desc:
1.d4 d5 2.c4 dxc4 3.e3 b5? 4.a4 c6 5.axb5 cxb5?? 6.Qf3. The queen hits the rook on a8 along the open diagonal; 6...Nc6 7.Qxc6+ wins a whole knight. It's the Queen's Gambit Accepted: Black should give the pawn back.

Did you know this one?

#chess #queensgambit #chesstraps

QGA2.ig:
Black keeps an extra pawn, and it costs him a whole knight on move seven. Did you know this one?

LTR2.title: A pawn becomes a knight on move 7, and Black wins the queen #shorts
LTR2.desc:
1.d4 d5 2.c4 e5 3.dxe5 d4 4.e3? Bb4+ 5.Bd2 dxe3 6.Bxb4?? exf2+ 7.Ke2 fxg1=N+ 8.Rxg1 Bg4+ 9.Ke1 Bxd1. The pawn becomes a knight with check, and the bishop skewers the queen behind the king. It's the Lasker trap in the Albin Countergambit.

Have you ever made a knight?

#chess #laskertrap #albincountergambit
LTR2.tags: chess, chess shorts, lasker trap, albin countergambit, underpromotion, chess traps, chess openings
LTR2.ig:
Black's pawn becomes a knight on move seven, and two moves later he wins the queen. Have you ever made a knight?

#chess #laskertrap #albincountergambit #underpromotion #chesstraps

KIE2.title: White wins a bishop on move 8 and it's checkmate on the spot #shorts
KIE2.desc:
1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 e5 3.dxe5 Ng4 4.Nf3 Nc6 5.Bf4 Bb4+ 6.Nbd2 Qe7 7.a3 Ngxe5 8.axb4?? Nd3#. The king can't move: his own pieces block every square, and the e2 pawn is pinned. It's the Kieninger trap in the Budapest Gambit.

Would you have grabbed the bishop?

#chess #budapestgambit #chesstraps
KIE2.tags: chess, chess shorts, kieninger trap, budapest gambit, smothered mate, chess traps, chess openings
KIE2.ig:
White wins a bishop on move eight, and it's checkmate on the spot. Would you have grabbed the bishop?

CKN2.title: Bring out a knight on move 5 and it's checkmate on move 6 #shorts
CKN2.desc:
1.e4 c6 2.d4 d5 3.Nc3 dxe4 4.Nxe4 Nd7 5.Qe2 Ngf6?? 6.Nd6#. The e7 pawn can't take the knight because the queen pins it to the king. It's a famous Caro-Kann trap.

Did you see it coming?

#chess #carokann #chesstraps

HAL2.desc:

MRT2.desc:

FSH3.title: Take the knight on move 6, and it's checkmate three moves later #shorts
FSH3.desc:
